channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Multiple arrests on suspicion of explosives offenses near U.K. base used by U.S. forces
item.description: Police evacuated homes Sunday near an air base in England used by the U.S. and arrested several men over suspected explosives offenses.

item.title: These Democrats are running for Congress on Christian faith. Will it pay off?
item.description: It's rare for Democrats to make religion a centerpiece of their campaigns. But this midterm election cycle, a number of candidates for Congress are doing just that.

item.title: Trump gave Xi Jinping a warm welcome. What did the talks accomplish?
item.description: From the National Archives to the state dinner, President Trump and Xi Jinping looked comfortable together in Washington. Two former NPR China correspondents on what the visit did and didn't deliver.

item.title: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'
item.description: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.

item.title: OPINION: Trump's U.N. speech, a stark contrast with past presidents
item.description: President Donald Trump mused openly before the United Nations about whether he should annihilate Iran. It's a stark contrast to how his predecessors have spoken about wielding US military power.

item.title: SCOTUS detention fight could unleash dangerous criminal migrants onto US streets, experts warns
item.description: A Supreme Court battle over bond hearings for detained noncitizens with criminal records could make it harder for ICE to keep detainees locked up.

item.title: Finland's Stubb credits Trump for pushing Ukraine peace talks while dismissing Russian invasion fears
item.description: Finnish President Alexander Stubb credits Trump with pushing for Russia-Ukraine war peace and says Finland is fully prepared for any Moscow threat.

item.title: Massive ICE sweep fuels GOP push to lock Trump immigration crackdown into law
item.description: Hoosier Sen. Jim Banks says a five-day ICE operation netting 426 arrests in Indiana proves why Trump's mass deportation agenda must become law.

item.title: Nicki Minaj urges young Americans to 'vote red' in 2026 midterms while doubling down on Trump support
item.description: Nicki Minaj urged young Americans to "vote red" in midterm elections and revealed why she's made it her mission to support President Donald Trump.

item.title: Hank Brown's last-second touchdown pass lifts Iowa to 20-19 win over Michigan in Big Ten
item.description: Hank Brown's 16-yard scoring strike to Reece Vander Zee with 2 seconds left gave the Iowa Hawkeyes a dramatic 20-19 Big Ten win over Michigan.

item.title: Israeli UN envoy's Starlink video reaches millions, with nearly 40% of Instagram viewers in Iran
item.description: Danny Danon's viral Starlink video drew 9 million views, with nearly 40% of Instagram viewers in Iran, his office says, prompting a counter-campaign.

item.title: After wildfires devastated Spokane, a high school became an oasis of normalcy
item.description: School-day routines — and even a loss on the football field — have provided relief for students and residents who lost everything.

item.title: States consider gas tax holidays ahead of Election Day
item.description: Since the Iran war sent gas prices soaring, Georgia, Kentucky and Indiana have cut or suspended their gas taxes. Similar proposals are under consideration in Ohio and Massachusetts.

item.title: A horror story unfolds as police examine pornographer’s brutal trove
item.description: A Philadelphia man created hundreds of thousands of degrading images of women, police say. At least five may have been dead when they were photographed or recorded.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri congressional map favoring GOP for third time
item.description: The ruling ends a complicated legal fight that has injected uncertainty into November’s midterm elections in the state.

item.title: Utah university releases independent review of Charlie Kirk shooting
item.description: The school commissioned the independent review after a gunman shot Charlie Kirk as he addressed a crowd on Sept. 10, 2025.

item.title: Ranchers accuse Trump administration of disrupting beef supply, as prices rise
item.description: Industry groups warned that ICE sweeps are “having a massive chilling effect on the legal, documented, skilled workers that put beef on the table.”

item.title: Hurricane Polo tracker: Map and projected storm path
item.description: Polo is the 18th named storm of the hurricane season.

item.title: Government can use Social Security data to identify noncitizen voters, Supreme Court rules
item.description: President Donald Trump wants to let states use a federal database that includes voters’ personal information to check for noncitizens on voter rolls.

item.title: Soaring diesel prices are clobbering Trump’s MAGA faithful, exposing rifts
item.description: Pain at the pump for rural Republicans is shifting the political map.
